summary: The Palestinian Land Authority is evidenced as the cadastral/land-registration custodian for Gaza. Its public citizen-services page links to a public ArcGIS parcel-location viewer whose Web Map contains EPSG:3857 polygon layers; a bounded comparison found two candidate TYPE3GAZA8 polygons near the exact preserved Deir el-Balah WUP point. No sample GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery queries are recorded verbatim in city-284-deir-el-balah.json under freshResearch. English discovery found the first-party Gaza Land Authority and public viewer; Arabic discovery found the land-registration, العقارية system, parcel-location service, and Deir el-Balah settlement announcement.
requestOutcomes: The public app configuration, Web Map metadata, Web Map data, official land-registration page, official Gaza settlement announcement, and public parcel-location service were read. The Web Map data was inspected only in ignored scratch evidence. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, unsafe fields, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: The public Web Map is a static May 2022 snapshot, not proof of current live coverage.
A bounded point-envelope comparison is not a citywide parcel inventory and is not a live feature-service query.
The exact point and [latitude, longitude] order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, registration-detail, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Completion records executed research only; runtime integration remains held pending independent serial qualification.
nativeFieldMapping: TYPE3GAZA8 exposes FID and OBJECTID plus Arabic parcel/block, classification, and area fields. OBJECTID was selected as the canonical identity for bounded evidence; source attributes were not retained.
compositeKeyProvenance: The source has block/parcel component fields and a display value, but no composite key was constructed.

geometryRetention.reason: Two candidate polygon geometries were verified in ignored Web Map scratch evidence, but no retained sample was written.

uncertainty: Current live endpoint availability, complete city coverage, and independent adapter semantics remain unverified.
